usedFor: Adalo holds your app's records, and Microsoft Excel keeps a running table that “Add Row To Table” extends.

bestTemplate.name: “new record is created” in Adalo, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every new Adalo record becomes a row in an Excel table, giving you a report-ready copy.

watchOut: Adalo's “record is updated” is polling and fires on edits, so the same record can reach Excel twice.
